messages:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: PAGER: high-severity - autoscaler failed to provision GPUs in eu-west3. queue_len rising to 1200, latency SLOs breaching. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/alloc-quotas
Maya (oncall): on it. noticed autoscaler logs show repeated 403s from GCP quota API. can someone confirm project-level GPU quota? :thinking_face:
Raj: checking now. running `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-prod` and quota list.
Raj: ok, project GPU quota for region eu-west3 shows 0 available. looks like recent claim boosted usage from another team cluster.
Sasha: is this a hard quota (project-level) or per-zone softlimit? if project-level we need quota request or fallback route.
Maya (oncall): we need immediate mitigation. priorities: 1) reduce incoming load (rate-limit/queue cutdown) 2) failover to alternate region 3) warm-pool fallback for reserve instances.
Tomas: I can flip routing for low-latency customers to eu-west1 and us-west2 for non-sensitive traffic. need a quick list of prefixes to shift.
Elaine (CS): FYI two enterprise customers (AcmeAnalytics, BrightPay) are seeing increased error rates in EU; Acme has live customers on EU-only policy. Preparing comms.
Raj: here's the relevant snippet from autoscaler logs: ```
[2026-03-15T10:12:02Z] autoscaler: request_instances -> got 403 QUOTA_EXCEEDED (region eu-west3)
[2026-03-15T10:12:03Z] autoscaler: retrying allocation after backoff (attempt 3)
[2026-03-15T10:12:10Z] autoscaler: all allocation attempts failed, queued requests increased by 320
```
Sasha: try forcing fallback to warm-pool variant: `POST /controlplane/fallbacks` body `{ "region": "eu-west3", "strategy": "warm-pool", "max_failover": 50 }` — infra needs to accept.
Infra-SRE: executing warm-pool failover now. creating warm instances in eu-west1/us-west2 and adjusting pool weights. watch logs.
Maya (oncall): also enabling temporary throttles on free-tier and background workloads to reclaim capacity for committed customers. Config patch pushed: ```yaml
routes:
  - name: low_priority
    rate_limit: 10rps
    priority: background
```
Raj: requested GCP quota increase via console (submitted support ticket 12345678), but GCP ETA is unknown. escalation pinged to our account rep.
Tomas: routing changes applied for traffic prefix /customer/acmeanalytics -> eu-west1; /customer/brightpay remains EU but in degraded mode (concurrency capped).
Elaine (CS): sending status update to Acme: short note saying we're failing over to eu-west1, possible increased tail latency, targeted ETA: 30-90m.
Maya (oncall): monitoring queue_len and token service errors. current queue_len 860 (down from 1200) after throttles+failover. latency p50 180ms -> 220ms, p95 spike to 1.8s.
Raj: additional context — quota used by `redwood-ml-batch` project activities spiked due to unbounded job from infra-tests. isolating that job now.
Sasha: recommend disabling cross-project batch jobs in eu-west3 for next 2 hours. patching autoscheduler rules.
Infra-SRE: identified offending job: `test-bulk-quantize-2026-03` — canceling now. reclaimed 24 GPUs.
Maya (oncall): great, queue_len 620. keep throttles in place until we get a stable reclaim or quota increase.
Elaine (CS): sending another note to customers: we have reclaimed capacity and are actively rerouting; will follow up with root cause and timeline.
Raj: GCP rep responded — quota increase approved but provisioning window is 4-6 hours. we should not expect immediate region quota bump.
Sasha: plan B: create temporary dedicated capacity in us-west2 and apply cross-region replication for stateful sessions. that will get critical customers back to normal.
Tomas: spinning up dedicated pool in us-west2 now. ETA ~12m for initial nodes.
Maya (oncall): logging incident details to postmortem tracker, tagging with customers impacted and mitigation timeline. assigning followups: - throttle rollback (Maya) - permanent quota request and org cleanup (Raj) - routing failover playbook update (Sasha) - customer debriefs (Elaine).
OpsBot: Incident recorded: IR-2026-0315-82. On-call handoff scheduled at 12:00 UTC to Raj.
Maya (oncall): handing off to Raj shortly. if anything regresses ping `@Raj` and `@Infra-SRE`. good job team, keep comms tight. :thumbsup:
Raj: taking over. continuing remediation and follow-ups.
